questions.subject: FRENCH
questions.topic: Attitude and the evidence offered for it
questions.learningObjective: Identify attitude and evidence in context

stimulus.body: Dans une note de travail consacrée à ce point, on lit: Quatre affirmations sont proposées; une seule est conforme à ce que la note établit réellement.

questions.stem: La note ci-dessus apporte des éléments pour juger cette forme. Quelle option est réellement appuyée par le texte, et pourquoi les autres échouent-elles ?

options.misconception: mistakes a surface feature of "A neutral attitude" for the governing rule
selects "An admiring attitude" where the rule in the passage requires a different condition
treats "An indifferent attitude" as if it followed from the evidence

questions.explanation: What settles the item is the relation stated in the passage: sharp adjectives, negative data, and a warning signal a critical attitude. On that basis "A critical attitude" is the supported choice. Option A ("A neutral attitude") fails because it mistakes a surface feature of "A neutral attitude" for the governing rule; Option C ("An admiring attitude") fails because it selects "An admiring attitude" where attitude and the evidence offered for it requires a different condition; Option D ("An indifferent attitude") fails because it treats "An indifferent attitude" as if it followed from the evidence.
